purpose: Teach: 手のひら/アクセント/モーニング/出来上がり/隣人/いわく/たかが/まかせ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、ママの手のひらに乗るおもちゃ、お気に入りね
lines.en: Sho, that little toy fits perfectly in my hand — you really love it, don't you?
lines.style: Warm, almost marveling tone. Gentle observation made softly, as if noticing something sweet without calling too much attention to it. Slight upward lilt on the final words.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんの英語、アクセントが独特だよね
lines.en: Mom, Dad's English accent is kind of unusual, isn't it?
lines.style: Quiet, genuinely curious observation. Not teasing — sincere noticing. Pause before the question, like he's been thinking about it. Soft, unrushed delivery.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが、モーニングコーヒー入れてくれたわよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad made the morning coffee for us.
lines.style: Light, pleased note of noticing something kind. Gentle tone, matter-of-fact but warm underneath. The small pride of witnessing thoughtfulness.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ケーキの出来上がり、すごい
lines.en: Mom, look — the cake turned out really well!
lines.style: Bright, genuine excitement breaking through. Quick, genuine upturn on 「すごい」. Pride in the accomplishment without overdoing it. A small person's real delight.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、隣人にもご挨拶、忘れないでね
lines.en: Sho, don't forget to say hello to the neighbors, okay?
lines.style: Gentle reminder, the tone of someone teaching manners without sternness. Warm instruction. Expectation of agreement, not command. Patient and present.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんいわく、運動が大事だって
lines.en: Mom, Grandpa says that exercise is really important — and he's right, isn't he?
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly earnest. He's connecting what he's been told to his own small understanding. Seeks affirmation gently. Quiet, observant pace.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、たかがテスト、気にしないでね
lines.en: Sho, it's just a test — don't let it worry you too much.
lines.style: Soft, reassuring. Not dismissive, but gentle deflation of anxiety. Her voice carries quiet confidence. The tone of someone who knows tests are small in the bigger picture.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんにお仕事まかせるよ
lines.en: Mom, I trust Dad to handle his work.
lines.style: Calm statement of confidence, delivered without fanfare. Quiet faith spoken plainly. Slightly older in tone — a small person understanding grown-up things. Settled.
